name: pb-hcf
description: Full custom-workflow integration for HCF v2.0.0+ via the frontmatter hook pipeline. Ships 14 enrollable agents at 7 hook points (pre-plan, post-plan, pre-implementation, post-batch, post-implementation, pre-commit, post-commit) covering pre-flight + protected-branch checks, Graphiti recall, prospective failure analysis, manual test-plan posting, per-task incident recall + constitution injection, structural + historical + mutation + security review, runtime error triage, adversarial final scan, verify-feature handoff, build-complete summary, and pipeline-firing audit — making /proxiblue-skills:workflow-build-feature obsolete. Multi-playbook wire installer (codegraph, graphiti, security, bricklayer, …) plus the 3-agent security quorum library, an interview skill for pre-plan scope building, and a modernization-sweep skill for apply-mode rector on existing code. Deterministic hook discovery via scripts/discover-hooks.sh + a SessionStart hook that auto-injects the resolved agent table into Claude's session context, bypassing HCF v2's LLM-improvised-bash discovery failure mode. HCF source untouched — pb-hcf works via context wiring (.claude/CLAUDE.md fenced section + .claude/<playbook>.md files) and host-side agent enrollment at the resolved target directory (auto-detected from .ddev mount source so RO-mount fleet gatekeeping is preserved; project-local .claude/agents/ fallback for non-fleet projects).
